g.text: Keys: [Up/Dn or j/k] Select | [Enter/O] Inspect | [G] Grafana | [U] Refresh | [?] Help
[Up/Dn] SELECT ROW [Enter/O] OPEN [G] GRAFANA [Left/Tab] TO MENU [U] REFRESH [?] HELP [Q] QUIT | Navigation: [Up/Dn] switch menu, [Right/Enter/Tab]
Controls: Up/Dn or j/k=Move | Left/Right/Tab=Switch | Enter=Open | 1-5=Tab | ?=Help | B/Esc=Back | Q=Quit
